title: I Let the Reserved-Erg Scanner Catch the Coach Who Sat on Mine

parts.text: I scanned the reserved erg at 5:41 a.m. and coach Britt was already on my numbered machine. The screen said RESERVED UNTIL 6:20. I was twenty-six, masters rower, holding a fob that listed my slot. Britt shrugged. "Coaches warm the drag." I photographed the screen, the fob, and her split on my monitor. Then I let the scanner ping. At 5:48 the front desk asked why Britt's name was on my erg. I kept my voice indoor and let the timestamp talk. Britt moved. Gym policy now has a second line: COACHES ARE NOT THE RESERVATION. I keep my fob on a labeled clip.
